name: Skendar Desert Warrior (CR 1/2)
body:
SKENDAR DESERT WARRIOR
CR 1/2

This humanoid is wrapped from head-to-foot in strips of sand-colored cloth. Even their eyes are covered by goggles, and mouth by a specialized filter, so that no part of them is visible. They carry a custom weapon with a specialized blade on one end and a hooked club on the other.

XP 200
Skendar ranger 1
N Medium humanoid (skendar)
Init +1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 armor)
hp 14 (1d10+3+1)
Fort +5, Ref +3, Will +2; +2 vs. poison (+4 vs. inhaled poison)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee skendar stick [spear end] +3 (1d8+3 P or S; brace) or skendar stick [club end] +3 (1d6+3 B or P; trip)
Ranged shortbow +2 (1d6/x3 P, range incr. 60 ft.)
Special Attacks favored enemy (human +2)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 13, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +3; CMD 14
Feats Dodge
Skills Handle Animal +2, Intimidate +2 (+4 vs. non-skendar), Knowledge (nature) +4, Perception +6, Ride +1, Stealth +5 (+9 in desert terrain), Survival +6 (+10 in desert terrain); Species Modifiers +4 Stealth in desert terrain, +4 Survival in desert terrain
Languages Skendar
SQ desert stride, survival gear, track +1, weapon familiarity, wild empathy -1
Gear NPC gear (skendar stick, shortbow with 20 arrows, other gear)

ABOUT

Skendars are masters of the desert, and claim wide swathes of remote and forbidding territory on several planets. They hold no love for humans and other advanced humanoids, who often challenge their traditional claim to these lands in order to establish mining colonies or claim other resources. Skendar desert warriors serve as the skendars’ front line in maintaining defense for their nomadic culture, scaring off trespassers, and avoiding a bloodbath at the hands of invaders.
